description: One dataset with typed records: song, artist, album, playlist, toplist, comment and error. Songs carry identifiers, singers, album, duration, cover art, file sizes, pay flags, chart rank when applicable and optional lyric/comment count. Artists carry bio, follower and catalog counts. Comments carry author, text, likes, replies and timestamps. Empty fields are omitted.

items.description: Dataset containing all scraped records. Use the recordType field to split songs, artists, albums, playlists, charts, comments and errors.
items.title: QQ Music records
